roles.label: Best overall batter
roles.description: Runs added over an average batter across the whole innings.

roles.label: Best powerplay batter
roles.description: Overs 1-6: how much a batter adds against the new ball and the field restrictions.

roles.label: Best middle-overs batter
roles.description: Overs 7-15: building and accelerating through the middle of the innings.

roles.label: Best finisher
roles.description: Overs 16-20: scoring fast without losing the wicket.

roles.label: Best overall bowler
roles.description: Runs saved and wickets taken above an average bowler across all overs.

roles.label: Best middle-overs bowler
roles.description: Overs 7-15: containing and taking wickets while the batters build.

roles.label: Best death bowler
roles.description: Overs 16-20: yorkers, slower balls and the last-over pressure.

roles.label: Best wicket-taker
roles.description: Wickets above what an average bowler takes from the same balls, valued at the cost of a wicket.

roles.label: Best at saving runs
roles.description: Runs saved against an average bowler, ignoring wickets.

roles.label: Best spinner
roles.description: Overall bowling value among spin bowlers.

roles.label: Best pace bowler
roles.description: Overall bowling value among pace bowlers.

roles.label: Best all-rounder
roles.description: Batting value plus bowling value, for players who do both.
